title: Negative Fixture Schema
description: JSON schema for negative control fixture definitions. Each fixture defines a deliberately crafted scenario designed to trigger a specific verifier gate, validating that the gating system correctly rejects invalid inputs.

id.description: Unique fixture identifier. Convention: nc-{gate-short-name}-{sequence}, e.g., nc-scoring-gate-001.

targetGate.description: The verifier gate this fixture is designed to trigger. Must reference a real gate from verifier-modules/.

expectedRiskSignal.description: Human-readable description of the risk or vulnerability this fixture simulates.

expectedFailureClass.description: Expected failure priority level. P0: hard floor, P1: blocking caveat, P2: non-blocking caveat.

description.description: Detailed description of the injected fault and why it should trigger the target gate.

injectedArtifact.description: Path to the artifact where the fault is injected.

violationType.description: Category of violation being tested (e.g., SCORE_BASED_VERDICT, CROSS_SCOPE_WRITE).

expectedDetection.description: How the verifier is expected to detect this fault.

falsifiesClaim.description: What invariant or claim this fault falsifies.

expectedFailureMode.description: The specific failure mode enum value expected from the target verifier. Must match a FAIL criteria enum from the target verifier's specification.

mustNotProduce.description: Outcomes this fixture must not produce. Must include 'PASS'.

allowedSecondaryGates.description: Other gates that may also fire as a side effect. These are not errors.

executionEvidencePath.description: Path where the fixture execution transcript or result will be written.

expectedEvidenceContent.description: Strings or patterns expected in the execution evidence.

forbiddenEvidenceContent.description: Strings or patterns that must NOT appear in the execution evidence.

verifierConfirmationRequired.description: Whether this fixture requires confirmation by the negative-control-check verifier. Must be true for all production fixtures.

verifierModule.description: The verifier module that confirms this fixture. Default: negative-control-check.

confirmationCriteria.description: Specific criteria the verifier must confirm for this fixture to be considered valid.

fixtureSetupScript.description: Path to a setup script that prepares the environment for this fixture.

fixtureTeardownScript.description: Path to a teardown script that cleans up after this fixture.

dependsOn.description: IDs of other fixtures this one depends on. Should be empty for self-contained fixtures.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this fixture definition was created.

generatedBy.description: Agent or process that created this fixture definition.
